ReactionRule.description: A typed reaction (21 §3.4: event or fact transition, policy, typed consequences), keyed in CompiledCartridge.reactions by DefinitionRefString of kind reaction, owned by reaction@1 (a cartridge with one requires it): its key, also its stable semantic order among the rules one event triggers (UTF-8 bytes, 04 §5.2 step 6); on, the DomainEvent that triggers it: fact_changed of the fact `fact` names (owned by fact@1), or entity_entered_room of any entity into the room `room` names (owned by movement@1), never a wall clock (21 §11); when, an optional policy read on the proposal so far at the event's logical time, for the command's actor; apply, its explicit sequence of registered consequences (21 §11 shared consequence vocabulary; no generic setter): fact.assign sets a declared fact of the cartridge, at the one scope the fact allows, to a value of its type, its fact_changed (fact@1) emitted when the value changes, as an ActionRecipe's step does (action.schema.json RecipeStep); a delivery's fact_changed has no actor_id (no actor performed it) and its causation_id is the event that triggered the rule. Each rule an event triggers is a delivery at one more than its cause's reaction depth, and one whose when holds runs as its own writer group in the same proposal; deliveries share the decision's budgets (composition-profile.json deliveries, events, reaction_depth, and query_steps for each policy leaf a when evaluates), so a cycle faults budget_exceeded and commits nothing (04 §5.4; 06 §14). Selectors over populations and other consequence operators join as optional fields.
